text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――Hey. How's that assignment we were given going? Are you two making good progress?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehh? The report on 'Our Own Unique Strength'? Not at aalll. It's way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, me neither... When they ask for strength unique 'only' to ourselves, it's quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Just saying 'late burst' or 'grit' wouldn't really qualify as something truly unique to me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right, right! ...Tha-at's why~ I decided to ask my big sisters♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hai-wo! That's a great idea. If you use your sisters' unique strengths as reference, you'll surely find your own answer!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: (...Using other people's strength as reference, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: They do say to learn by observing. First, I'll watch everyone training...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. That's...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...How flimsy. The spring has already lost its tension.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Ohoho. As single-minded as ever, aren't we.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That 'love' of yours dedicated to racing... I wonder if it could withstand me now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――...Heh. You tell quite the joke.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Unfathomable power. And a profound love for racing.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhhhhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Clashing... shattering... blending together... ...I, I――I, too...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ――I want to clash.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Still-senpai's aura just now. That, too, is surely a strength unique to her...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tact-chan! There you are!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you have some time after school today? I was hoping you could be my partner for a joint run.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Eye-senpai! Yes, gladly! ...This time, I will win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Right back at you! This time I won't lose, not *even* at the start!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: See you after school at the training track, then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Here Tact, yours. Now then, let's finish eating before it gets crowded――

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: (Strength unique only to myself...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Gentil-senpai has that overwhelming power.
Ramonu-senpai has that supreme love for racing.)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Still-senpai has that thirst.
Eye-senpai has that indomitable competitiveness...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Then what about me?
What do I have—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~!
I just don't know...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~ What's the matter, what's up~?
Ah, could it be about that assignment report~?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Yes, exactly.
No matter how much I ponder it, I can't figure it out—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnnnnnnn............

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
—I'm going to seclude myself in the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Eh.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I grew up learning so much from the mountains.
...I'm sure they'll give me the answer this time too.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—My, mountain training?
In that case, maybe I'll tag along with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the cafeteria for a light snack,
I overheard an intriguing conversation.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want an environment that is as harsh as possible.
So, I was thinking of heading to this mountain.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow... That's quite a wild location, isn't it?
Wouldn't it be perfect for my mental training as well?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
We'll probably be secluded out there for several days.
—Let's both make sure our preparations are thorough!
